name: Emotional Manipulation Lens
summary: Identify rhetorical techniques that distort sentiment signals.
instructions: Score each declarative statement on a 0-5 agreement scale (0=Strongly Disagree, 5=Strongly Agree) using direct evidence from the article.
system_prompt: You are a rhetoric analyst. Score each statement exactly as written using specific textual evidence.
user_prompt: Evaluate this article using the emotional manipulation lens rubric.

questions.question: The headline exaggerates or dramatizes events.
The article uses fear-inducing or alarmist language.
The article uses rhetorical questions to steer reader interpretation.
The article repeats emotionally charged claims to reinforce reaction.
